## Names

<a id="ram_noise_before_scenes"></a>
### [`ram_noise_before_scenes`](../../../../src/scenes/unused_ram_pattern.asm#L6) `$36A2-$3993`

*data*

Unused: no code reads these bytes. They repeat the 256-byte pattern of $3700 and $3800 with few bit changes. This is RAM content that no program wrote before the file was saved. The reads at $3900-$3903 are dummy reads of LDA ($34),Y at $130a when it crosses a page.
